title: Emergency Gate
description: JSON schemas for the emergency-gate Edge Function request and response payloads

pet_id.description: Optional UUID of the specific pet to verify. If omitted, any verified pet owned by the caller grants access.

query_text.description: The user's emergency message. Stored in emergency_gate_logs; not used for gate logic.

SuccessResponse.description: Returned on every authenticated POST — HTTP 200

allowed.description: true if the caller has a verified pet profile and may proceed to Tier 3 (Opus) triage; false otherwise

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the gate decision

nearest_vet_url.description: Google Maps universal URL for the nearest emergency vet. Always present regardless of the allowed value.

ErrorResponse.description: Returned on 401 (missing/invalid JWT), 405 (wrong method), or 500 (unhandled error)
